title: YouTube Shopping affiliate
one_liner: Tag products in your videos and earn when viewers buy.
followers: YouTube Partner Program from 500 subscribers (since 27 Mar 2026), in eligible countries.
pay: Brands set the commission. Paid via AdSense 60-120 days after the purchase; returns reverse it.
steps: Join the expanded YouTube Partner Program at 500 subscribers.
Turn on Shopping in YouTube Studio.
Tag products you use in videos and Shorts.
catch: Slow payouts (60-120 days), country limits, and many enrolled creators earn small amounts.
sources: PPC Land: YouTube Shopping opens to 500 subscribers (Mar 2026)
PPC Land: 35 markets by year end (Sep 2026)

match.first_step: Pick 3 products you use and plan a video showing them.
